description: Fires on the move that completes a named trap's setup (step_label='setup_completed'). The {trap_description} comes from data/traps.json — adding a new trap = adding a JSON entry there, no edits here.

fact_glossary.trap_name: Authored trap name from data/traps.json (e.g. 'Fried Liver Attack')
fact_glossary.this_move_by_user: true when the user is the one setting up the trap (rare — usually opp does)
